items.title: OpenAI API adds optional 12-hour prompt caching
items.summary: Developers can now keep shared instructions, tool definitions and context cached for up to 12 hours instead of the default short window, so agents that run on a schedule keep paying the cached-input rate between sparse calls.

reception.summary: Builders welcomed it for scheduled and always-on agents and worked through the pricing: the 12-hour write costs more than the default write, so it pays off once a cache would otherwise go cold twice; a few off-topic complaints about the dots agent's quality and speed.

items.title: Google and Meta open-source TorchTPU, native PyTorch on TPUs
items.summary: TorchTPU is a native PyTorch backend for Google TPUs with true eager execution and a torch.compile backend, plus vLLM and SGLang serving and TorchTitan training at scale, so existing PyTorch code can move to TPUs with minimal changes.

items.title: LangSmith adds Managed Deep Agents with per-user credentials and memory
items.summary: LangChain now hosts Deep Agents as a managed service that gives each end user their own credentials and memory, for teams serving one agent to many people.

items.title: Command Code launches Mods Hub, an open-source registry for agent mods
items.summary: Command Code users can discover, install and publish mods that add tools, commands, hooks and rules to the coding agent, with 30-plus available at launch.

items.title: Arena: GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6.1 Sol hold 6 of 11 Agent Arena Pareto frontier spots
items.summary: Arena's cost versus performance frontier for agent tasks shows Luna leading under $0.10 per task and Sol between $0.22 and $0.65, with different reasoning-effort levels of the same model filling several frontier spots.

items.title: Warp reports 40% more merged PRs and 67% lower cost per PR with Warp Factories
items.summary: Warp says three months of running its own agent software factory, with agent quality measurement, model benchmarking and self-improvement loops, raised merged PRs 40% and cut cost per PR 67%, and it walks through the setup in Warp Factories.

doubt.pushback: Internal, self-reported figures with no baseline, method or data shown in the post.

reception.summary: Posted minutes before the sweep; no replies or quote posts were readable yet.

items.title: SoMark releases OXR, a 1.3B open document parsing model
items.summary: OXR turns PDFs and document images into Markdown or JSON with layout coordinates, using a swappable layout module; SoMark says the 1.3B model ranks first on olmOCR-Bench, OmniDocBench and DocParsingBench and leads open models on speed, with weights and reproduction steps published.

doubt.pushback: Benchmark rankings are self-reported with the paper still pending, the repo is new with few stars, and early quote posts come mostly from low-engagement aggregator accounts.
